notes.title: Long-Awaited Update
notes.content:
We’ve been deep in the development of Winter Burrow over the past few months, which is why we haven’t posted here for a while. But now, we’ve finally popped our heads out of the burrow to have a chat!

Hello, I'm Benjamin, CEO and Creative Director at Pine Creek Games. Every day, I’m amazed by what the team designs, creates, and develops. We’ve added more creatures that now roam the world. NPCs have come to life through character descriptions and dialogue. New areas with their own unique environments are growing out of the once-blank canvas. New features have been designed and implemented.

These are some of the things I'm most excited about! 😊

I’m incredibly excited about our new Weather System. It adds so much atmosphere to the game while introducing unique gameplay experiences. Imagine exploring a new area in thick fog or getting caught in a fierce snowstorm—these are now dynamic events you can encounter in Winter Burrow. But don’t worry, we won’t throw a blizzard at you right away! We’ll make sure you’ve had time to settle in before the weather turns wild. ⛄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/1a422297949b64fb6bbeb04f06c2537f08f5550c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/7ccecd08a5dc6dd98832aee07a334d2849e78ac5.jpg[/img]

We’ve also improved the Furnishing System, allowing you to customize your home burrow to your heart’s content. We’ve designed different furniture sets, each with its own distinct style and requiring unique resources to craft. The system is designed to be simple—so we can develop it within our timeline while ensuring stability—but it still offers plenty of ways to arrange furniture and decorate your space just the way you like. You can also easily disassemble or move furniture if needed. It’s still in development, but here’s a little preview of our progress:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/c60d6189269ffc0aaba4295165f910e2ce449d7a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/77a9b9be3baf75d520d7dc6f0b2eeeabb019e49b.jpg[/img]

Now, I’ll crawl back into the burrow and continue working on the game. We can’t wait to share more with you about all the new features and content. That’s all for now—remember to drink some hearty tea, enjoy a delicious pie, and most importantly... stay cozy!

Have a mice day! 🐭

notes.title: End of Winter Borrow demo - for now
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for your support and feedback during the Winter Burrow demo! We're incredibly grateful for the time you took to play and share your thoughts with us. Now, it's time to take the demo down *for now*, but here’s what we’ve learned:
[list]
[*] The sound: Wow, way too loud! We apologize for that. We should have tested it better, and we’ll make sure to fix this in future builds.
[*] Keyboard controls: We hear you! While our initial focus has been on controller support, especially with the exciting Xbox partnership and Gamescom booth, keyboard controls will absolutely be included in the final game.
[*] Co-op requests: That sounds super fun. However, for now, we’re concentrating on delivering a fantastic single-player experience with our small team.
[*] Localization: Yes, the game will be localized! We’ll keep you updated when we have more specifics on the languages.
[/list]

We’re already working on a new demo based on your feedback, and we can't wait to show you the new features. Once we have a release date, you’ll be the first to know!

Thank you for being part of our journey, and after the whirlwind of Gamescom and Pax West, we’re eager to dive back into game development. Stay tuned for more updates! 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053476/83d87c79c79a893b6a5263acade6d9b510799d12.jpg[/img]
